findings.ac: AC4: tests/install-harness passes 100% against the new canonical bundle
findings.text: run-L2.py assert_tree still has an unchanged antigravity branch that expects <plugins>/stratosphere-os/plugin.json and plugin/scripts/scaffold.py, which the canonical dist/skills bundle no longer provides. prompts/claude-global.txt still tells the agent to run scripts/install-claude-code.ps1 (installer of the retired dist/claude-code tree). Only L1 and the claude-code branch of L2 were migrated, so '100%' is not shown for the whole harness.

findings.ac: Stress case: missing transitive reference makes build.py exit status 1
findings.text: test_missing_cited_reference_is_a_fatal_build_error calls build.closure_for directly with a DIRECT missing citation and only asserts SystemExit.code not in (0, None); sys.exit(str) gives a string code. No test covers a missing reference reached transitively (an existing reference that cites a missing one), and none runs build.py as a subprocess to assert returncode == 1.

findings.ac: AC1: python build/build.py succeeds with zero errors and emits exactly 26 skill dirs
findings.text: test_single_bundle_emits_exactly_26_skills only counts directories in the committed dist/skills tree; no pytest runs build.py and checks exit 0 or that a fresh build emits 26. build_bundle() has no in-code count assertion; the guarantee rests on the scripts/check.sh drift check outside the pytest suite.

findings.ac: AC3: All 26 skills preserve relative references/
findings.text: test_every_cited_reference_is_shipped_inside_the_skill checks only names cited directly in each SKILL.md via build.cited_refs; it does not check the transitive closure (references cited by shipped references) or that the shipped references resolve as relative references/ paths for all 26 skills.

findings.ac: AC4 support: install tests coverage retained
findings.text: tests/scripts/test_install_overlay.py::_require_build still checks dist/claude-code/skills/plan-html, which BT-118 deletes, so the installer overlay tests now always pytest.skip. The scripts/install-*.sh/.ps1 installers are still present and unreferenced by the new harness, so that coverage is silently dropped rather than updated.
